verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is a SaaS customer-service AI platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents an MCP server, simulations and integrations, but nothing about versioned APIs, version identifiers, or a deprecation or sunset policy. With no evidence for this applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
